summary: Paul J Lipsky compares Anthropic's two Claude models, Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, for creative visual work, noting Fable 5.2 costs roughly twice as much as Opus 5.5 and asking whether the higher price is justified for design tasks.

Using the Higgsfield MCP integration in Claude, he runs both models through identical tests — image ads, a UGC-style video ad, a full commercial with open creative freedom, a complete website, and a 3D animated story ad — so that any differences come from the model itself rather than the underlying image/video generation tools, since both models call the same Higgsfield outputs.

The video is sponsored by Higgsfield (with a discount link and MCP setup instructions for Claude), fitting the channel's recurring format of head-to-head AI tool/model comparisons aimed at creators deciding which paid AI subscription is worth the money.
